ns2:section.sectionText: Long Title: Design of Digitally Mediated Information Services. Bi-Modal class; on-campus students will attend class in Room 52 LISB. The instructors will broadcast to LEEP synchronous to the on-campus course. Registration is through Academic Outreach. On-campus students (need to contact Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@uiuc.edu) to enroll. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Required on-campus session Saturday, March 4. See section description at http://www.lis.uiuc.edu/oc/courses/catalog/catalog.html
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
